question: Who won the Sportstar of the Year (Male) award at the Sportstar Aces Awards 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PR Sreejesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PR Sreejesh**, the celebrated Indian hockey goalkeeper, won the prestigious **Sportstar of the Year (Male)** award at the **Sportstar Aces Awards 2025**.
 
• He has been a vital part of the Indian national hockey team and played a significant role in India's historic bronze medal win at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**, marking India's first Olympic hockey medal in 41 years.
 
• Sreejesh is renowned for his exceptional goalkeeping skills, quick reflexes, and ability to deliver under pressure. His performance has often been the backbone of India's success in crucial matches.
 
• He has previously been honored with prestigious awards such as the **Khel Ratna Award** (India's highest sporting honor) in **2021** and the **Padma Shri** in **2017**.
 
• The **Sportstar Aces Awards** recognizes outstanding achievements in Indian sports, celebrating athletes who have made remarkable contributions to their respective fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PR Sreejesh:**

 
 
• **Full Name:** Parattu Raveendran Sreejesh.
 
• **Born:** May 8, 1988, in **Kizhakkambalam**, Kerala, India.
 
• **Position:** Goalkeeper in field hockey.
 
• Sreejesh has been the **captain** of the Indian hockey team and is known for his leadership qualities on and off the field.
 
• He has represented India in several international tournaments, including the **Asian Games**, **Commonwealth Games**, and **World Cups**.
 
 
 
• **Sportstar Aces Awards:**
 
 
• These awards are an initiative by the **Sportstar magazine** to honor excellence in Indian sports annually.
 
• Categories include individual awards for male and female athletes, team awards, and special recognition awards for lifetime achievements.
 
• Winners are selected by a jury comprising former athletes, journalists, and sports administrators.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of PR Sreejesh:**
 
 
• Played a pivotal role in India's victory at the **2021 FIH Hockey Pro League**.
 
• Awarded the **Best Goalkeeper** title multiple times in international tournaments, including the **Asian Champions Trophy** and the **Hockey World League**.
 
• Contributed significantly to India's gold medal wins in the **2014 Asian Games** and the **2017 Asia Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Hockey Team’s Achievements:**
 
 
• India has a glorious history in hockey, being the most successful team in Olympic history with **8 gold medals**.
 
• The team’s recent resurgence, including the **Tokyo Olympics 2020 bronze medal**, has been attributed to the contributions of players like PR Sreejesh, Manpreet Singh, and others.
 
• The team is currently ranked among the top hockey nations globally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Hockey in India:**

 
 
• Hockey is considered the **national sport** of India, and the country has a rich legacy of producing world-class players.
 
• Legends like **Dhyan Chand**, Balbir Singh Sr., and now PR Sreejesh have contributed significantly to the sport's popularity.
 
 
 
• **Sportstar Aces Awards 2025:**
 
 
• Other notable winners in 2025 included **Neeraj Chopra** (Sportstar of the Year - Athletics) and **PV Sindhu** (Sportstar of the Year - Female).
 
• The awards aim to inspire young athletes and recognize the hard work and dedication of Indian sports personalities.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020 Bronze Medal:**
 
 
• India defeated Germany 5-4 in a thrilling match to secure the bronze medal in men’s field hockey.
 
• PR Sreejesh’s heroic saves in the final minutes of the match were instrumental in the victory.
